title: Emberwake heroes and crypt figures gain distinct silhouettes
summary: Rook, Mira and Silas, hollow archers, salt wraiths and the Bellkeeper received authored silhouettes in merged PR 24. This proposed gallery presentation uses new matched scene and enlarged captures; publication is separate. Art review was sampled, and CPU submission timings do not measure GPU FPS.

title: Cartographer map cues enter repository review
summary: Author reviewed occupied doorways and threat marks at desktop and phone sizes. The local default gate passed 574 application tests and 37 simulations; nine browser journeys passed, including full expedition victory and historical saves. The prior 643 SVGs are unchanged. Human recognition and enjoyment remain untested; the linked PR records hosted CI.

title: Cartographer retains occupied doorway cues and separates threat marks
summary: Author inspected matched desktop and phone captures, including 320 px controls. Occupied cell labels retain the doorway direction; threat cells and accepted commands are unchanged in the matched fixture. Static cues support reduced motion. Human recognition and enjoyment remain untested. Local candidate only; no PR or hosted CI has been submitted.

title: Spire, Blindside and Hearth reviews coexist
summary: The integration rehearsal passed 21 browser journeys and eight focused tests. All 643 SVG exports are unchanged; independent comparisons and earlier history are retained. The linked PR records the final combined gates. Human gameplay testing remains pending.

title: Last Hearth names lost shields on the affected minion
summary: Author reviewed the cue at 64/22/18 px and in desktop/phone combat. Eleven focused browser journeys pass; all 643 SVGs decode and the original 642 remain byte-identical. The default gate passes 573 application tests and 37 simulations. Matched saves and combat results are unchanged. Human gameplay testing remains pending; the PR records hosted CI.

title: Blindside scoring shows its source and changed values
summary: Author reviewed card, Joker and cash-only effects at desktop and phone sizes. Eleven focused browser journeys pass, including exact values, pause/seek, reduced motion and unchanged saves. The local default gate passes 571 application tests and 37 simulations. Matched saves and score steps are identical before/after. Human gameplay testing remains pending; the PR records hosted CI.

title: Default checks pass; complete CI coverage split across jobs
summary: The default local gate now passes 570 application tests and 37 simulations. Independent scenarios have their own test deadlines; application workers are bounded and CI uses two complete shards plus a separate simulation job. No timeouts increased or coverage removed. Asset images are unchanged. Human gameplay testing remains pending.

title: Intent cues reviewed; phone overlap and size budget corrected
summary: The first blade was too narrow and the gallery PNGs exceeded budget. A wider diagonal blade, compact cues and lossless WebP resolved those issues; phone shortcuts no longer cover combat. Author reviewed 32/64 px, desktop and phone views. Focused browser checks: 7/7; five-game smoke: 5/5. Full app gate: 558 passes, 3 five-second timeouts; unchanged baseline reproduces the Hearth timeout. Gameplay testing is pending.

title: Spire intent-cue pilot and independent review gallery
summary: Six action symbols, exact next-action text, and a visible target marker. Matched combat captures and independent comparisons are prepared for review.
